fusions.name: Roped and Thrown
fusions.desc: Throws a loop of cord that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and throws it down, leaving it [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ox-Drawn Trawl
fusions.desc: Drags a wide mesh forward through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything caught in it plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaving each [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Herd Them In
fusions.desc: Ropes up to 6 enemies within 6 tiles and pulls them onto you, holding their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Taut Coils
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a coil of rope winds onto that enemy, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all spend at once: the rope snaps taut and strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per coil (163% at full). Unfed, a coil fades every 4 seconds.
